prerequisites: Participation in the mathematical preparatory course is recommended

learning_outcomes.text: Students master the basics of one-dimensional analysis.
They can confidently handle complex numbers, sequences and series, limits, and functions.
They understand central concepts such as continuity, differentiability, or integrability, and are familiar with important statements regarding these.
Students can comprehend the justifications of these statements presented in the lecture and independently justify simple statements built upon them.
They are familiar with the application of elementary proof techniques.
Students are able to work in teams and master mathematics as a common language.
They can check their understanding of complex concepts, pinpoint open questions, and seek targeted help if necessary.
Students have developed sufficient perseverance to work purposefully on more difficult problems.

assessment_methods.method: Oral exam (30 minutes, individual exam) if < 10 participants

assessment_rules: Homework assignments are a mandatory prerequisite for the exam. The final grade is based on a written exam (120 minutes) if there are 10 or more participants. If there are fewer than 10 participants, an oral exam (30 minutes, individual) will be conducted.
